event_summary: An upright blue rectangular prism on a circular base visibly changes its facing while its wall shadow and the surrounding light patch remain mostly steady.
raw_event_description: The video shows a blue vertical rectangular prism standing on a round metallic-looking base on a tabletop in front of a wall. A large bright circular light patch is projected onto the wall, with a dark vertical rectangular shadow and a horizontal shadow band near the lower wall. Across the sequence, the blue prism stays upright and in the same image location, while the visible faces, edge highlights, and apparent width of the prism change gradually. The wall shadow remains in approximately the same position and keeps a similar vertical-and-horizontal shape. The camera view appears fixed.

reasons: The upright blue prism, circular base, tabletop, wall, projected light patch, and shadow are all visible at the start.
The visible change appears already in progress rather than beginning from a distinct onset.
